scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
In this highly competitive society, we must be different in order to survive!
I only refine equipment at the +6 ~ 12 levels.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
競爭這麼激烈，不拿出點特色怎麼生存！
我只精煉+6~+12的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
I will need ^ff9999Blessed Oridecon^000000 for weapons, and ^ff9999Blessed Elunium^000000 for armors.
Failed refines ^FF0000will not break or reduce the refine level^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
精煉武器需要^ff9999受祝福的武器礦石^000000，精煉防具需要^ff9999受祝福的防具礦石^000000。
精煉失敗^FF0000不會損壞裝備或降低精煉等級^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
How about it? Do you want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
怎麼樣？你想精煉嗎？

scripts.text: [Blacksmith Dister]
scripts.translation: [鐵匠 迪斯特]

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
I'm a blacksmith, not a hairstylist.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
我是鐵匠，不是理髮師。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
With my hammer, I will make you a star of the sky.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
一錘下去，送你上天當星星。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Making artificial hands is not my specialty.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
製作假手不是我的專長。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Bring out the item so I can refine it!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
把要精煉的物品拿出來吧！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Where is this weird smell coming from?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
這股奇怪的味道是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Where is the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
飾品在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
What do you want me to refine?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
你想讓我精煉什麼？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Huh? What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
嗯？你想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
This item cannot be refined.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
這個物品無法精煉。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
This equipment has refined to {0}. I only handle items with refine levels from +6 to +12!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
這件裝備已經精煉到{0}了。我只負責精煉等級在+6到+12之間的物品！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
This {0} has been refined to {1}. To refine it, I need {2} and a {3} zeny refining fee.
Do you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
{0}目前精煉到{1}，繼續精煉需要{2}和{3} Zeny手續費。
要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
I am busy, don't joke with me!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
我很忙，別跟我開玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
This {0} has been refined many times. Although it will not disappear upon failure, the {1} will disappear!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
{0}已經精煉過不少次了，雖然失敗不會損毀裝備，但{1}還是會消耗掉！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Of course, the refining fee will not be returned! Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
當然，精煉費是不會退還的！你確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Good. I'd be sad if it failed, too.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
很好。如果失敗了，我也會很難過的。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Materials insufficient.
To refine a level {0} {1}, I need {2} and a {3} zeny refining fee.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
材料不夠。
精煉等級{0}的{1}，需要{2}和{3} Zeny手續費。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Tac! Tac! Tac!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
叮！叮！叮！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Hahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Refine was a huge success~ Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
精煉大成功~ 哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Oh my goodness!!!!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
天哪！！！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
Oh! Although it was blessed by {0} to retain the equipment...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
哎呀！多虧{0}的祝福，裝備才保住了...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Dister]
My mood is worse when I fail!!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 迪斯特]
精煉失敗，我心情也不好！！
